description:
Speech-to-text for a public MP3 or WAV file (audio_url, up to 30 minutes / 30 MB): returns the transcript, detected language, timestamped segments and optional SRT/VTT subtitles (format=srt|vtt); task=translate returns English. Paid only, metered per started audio minute: the file length is read before payment, so the payment terms quote the exact total. Charged only when a transcript is returned. Machine transcription can contain errors.
Not for: m4a, ogg, flac or webm files (convert to MP3 or WAV first).

[Transcribe via YourAITools MCP Hub] No free tier (paid route only). Paid: transcribe $0.003 per audio minute (rounded up, min 1), quoted exactly for your file before you pay, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of an MP3 or WAV file (up to 30 minutes / 30 MB). Or POST the file as the raw body (Content-Type audio/mpeg or audio/wav), or JSON audio_base64.

format.description: json (default); srt or vtt also returns subtitles in the srt / vtt field

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language (e.g. en, es, de); detected when omitted

prompt.description: Optional context words or spellings (max 500 chars)

tier.description: Paid tier: transcribe $0.003 per audio minute (rounded up, min 1). Default transcribe.

vad.description: Skip silence with voice activity detection (default false)

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe: Transcribe audio (speech-to-text)
